headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 18, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Boston Red Sox in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Nathan Lukes leading the Blue Jays' offense. The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers, while the Minnesota Twins dominated the Texas Rangers 9-3. The Seattle Mariners shut down the Baltimore Orioles in a 3-0 shutout win, and the Chicago Cubs cruised past the Toronto Blue Jays 16-2.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with Michael Helman being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture. Ryne Nelson was placed on the 15-day injured list with a strained right elbow, and Wenceel Pérez was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left orbital fracture. Mike Trout was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain, and Everson Pereira was placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Atlanta Braves trading Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners traded Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the Toronto Blue Jays traded Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals traded Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finalizing the score at 4-3. Nathan Lukes led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and one RBI.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Parker Messick earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Rangers 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-3 victory over the Texas Rangers, led by Trevor Larnach's impressive 3-hit, 1-home run performance. Joe Ryan earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Orioles in Shutout Win**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 3-0 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Bryan Woo pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 9 and allowing just 3 hits. Andrés Muñoz earned the save in the win.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Blue Jays 16-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Toronto Blue Jays in a lopsided 16-2 victory, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring performance. Impact hitters for the Cubs included George Springer, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Ian Happ, Nico Hoerner, and Carson Kelly.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Helman Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture.

top_news.title: **Stratton Heads to Pittsburgh in Trade**
top_news.summary: Hunter Stratton, a right-handed pitcher, was traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates on June 18, 2026, in exchange for catcher Joey Bart.
